info.name: Microsoft Azure Gets The List Of Audio And Transcription Logs That Have Been Stored For A Given Endpoint

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the endpoint.

params.name: sasValidityInSeconds
params.description:
The duration in seconds that an SAS url should be valid. The default duration is 12 hours.
            When using BYOS (https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/speech-service/speech-encryption-of-data-at-rest#bring-your-own-storage-byos-for-customization-and-logging): A value of 0 means that a plain blob URI without SAS token will be generated.

params.name: skipToken
params.description: Token to skip logs that were already retrieved in previous requests. Pagination starts from beginning when not defined.

params.name: top
params.description: Number of datasets that will be included after skipping.

items.docs: Needs a more full description created.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Deletes The Specified Audio And Transcription Logs That Have Been Stored For A Given Endpoint It Deletes All Logs Before And Including A Specific Day

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the endpoint.

params.name: endDate
params.description:
The end date of the audio logs deletion (specific day, UTC).
            Expected format: "yyyy-mm-dd". For instance, "2019-09-20" results in deleting all logs on September 20h, 2019 and before.
            Deletes all existing logs when date is not specified.

items.docs: The deletion process is done asynchronously and can take up to one day depending on the amount of log files.
